baseline_suite ran three test files to 54 passed while after_suite ran four files to 96 passed, so the recorded added_failure_count 0 compares arms over different selections rather than the same suite at two revisions; the base arm excludes tests/discovery/test_signal_enrichment_grounding.py, which is the file holding every new guard, so the base arm cannot show what those tests did before the change.

the precomputed branch stores the caller's vector while stamping `embedded_text_hash` from the text the writer derived, so a vector obtained for different text is written with a hash that matches the stored description and the re-embed sweep at _SIGNAL_HASH_MISMATCH_WHERE never repairs it, which is the stale-vector state the writer's own docstring says it exists to prevent.
